localRepair.reason: Meshy painted the can's stencil as "516" (front and back panels; primary review) instead of the 5.56 caliber. Authorized by the task: "locally corrected typography / decals are fine if generated text is poor".
localRepair.method: object-space panel projection: yellow stencil masked (colour rule) + dilated 7 px (its dark halo too), filled from the surrounding paint (push-pull inpainting + seeded grain at the panel's own luminance spread), "5.56" composed from the generated stencil's own glyphs, written back to every atlas texel of the panel (face normal toward the view, on the panel plane; bilinear from the decal) + a 3 px gutter bleed; the embossed "516" relief in the normal map flattened (128,128,255) inside the old mask. Metallic-roughness unchanged. Base colour / normal edited at 2048 px before downsizing.

newStencil.from: the generated stencil's own glyphs: "5" (x2), "6", dot = a square cut from the foot of the "1"
